rec.name: Testimonial Videos Carousel with Social-Proof Badge
rec.status: Built — launched (styling feedback implemented and approved)

what.text: A horizontally scrolling carousel of vertical customer testimonial videos, each with a centered play-button overlay. Above or beside it sits a heading ("Wir lassen unsere Kund:innen sprechen." = "We let our customers speak."), a subheading ("Schau dir an, was andere über GOLDKINDCHEN sagen:" = "See what others say about GOLDKINDCHEN:") and a round yellow badge reading "50.000+ Kund:innen lieben GOLDKINDCHEN" (50,000+ customers love GOLDKINDCHEN). On desktop the text block sits to the left of the video row; on mobile the text stacks above the videos with the badge on the right and the videos below.

why.text: Real customer videos are strong social proof: they show the product in real use and give peer validation that polished brand imagery cannot. The "50,000+ customers" badge adds a bandwagon effect and a quantified trust signal at the point of decision. Video also lets shoppers see size, texture and results, which lowers purchase uncertainty.

how.text: Build a theme section named "Testimonial Videos" with text settings (heading, subheading, button text, button link) and an inline SVG field for a custom play-button icon with a pulse/shine animation. Add repeatable video blocks with a vertical poster/video and a play overlay, laid out as a horizontal scroll/slider. Add a circular badge, absolutely positioned, with its own text. Typography: heading in the store heading font (Miamo 400, uppercase, about 30px/36px), and subheading and badge text in the body font (Nunito, about 16px for the subheading). Add mobile CSS for the badge (about 100×100px, 9px font, 8px padding, line-height 1.5), with prose max-width calc(100% - 150px) so text does not collide with the badge, and a negative top offset (about -90px) to overlap the badge with the video row. Container padding is 80px top and bottom.

items: Typography: heading font = Miamo uppercase; subheading and badge = Nunito

dependencies.text: Theme must have the heading font (Miamo) and body font (Nunito) loaded. Videos are hosted in Shopify files or via a video source (not specified in the ticket). Play icon is custom inline SVG. The section is named "Testimonial Videos" and carries section-specific CSS. The ticket title says PDP, but the screenshots show the section sitting below a hero/"Jetzt entdecken" block above a "Themenwelten" section, which looks more like a homepage or landing page, so page placement is uncertain.

images.caption: Theme editor view of the Testimonial Videos section (mobile preview): heading, subheading, button text/link and play-button SVG fields, with the badge and video cards.
Desktop layout: text block on the left, badge overlapping the first video, horizontal row of vertical testimonial videos with play buttons.
Mobile layout with the heading, subheading and badge above the videos, plus the CSS for the badge size, text max-width and negative offset.
Font inspector: heading in Miamo 400 (~30px/36px, uppercase) and subheading in Nunito 400 (16px/24px).
Final state: badge text switched to Nunito (500, 13px) as the customer requested, with the heading still in Miamo.
